dct_description_sm: This dataset includes all data and code needed to reproduce the analyses in the manuscript "Effects of road closures on vertebrate mortality rates: Conservation implications in a highly visited peri-urban park" by Tremblay Estable et al. Please refer to the ReadMe file for an overview of this dataset.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Effects of road closures on vertebrate mortality rates: Conservation implications in a highly visited peri-urban park
